title: Swarm: chaos backplane partition (docker restarted after nft)
description: Runs `nexus chaos swarm network-partition --target swarm-worker-3 --duration 30 --yes`. Drops the VMnet10 backplane on a worker (the mgmt NIC stays up), observes the partition (consul 5/1, worker 2/3 Ready), then lifts it and restarts docker to rebuild the ingress-mesh DNAT.

observe.what: observed impact shows the worker partitioned off consul/swarm; after lift + docker restart the cluster recovers

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync partitions the backplane CIDR (not the mgmt NIC) and restarts docker after the nft scenario lifts ([[nftables-flush-ruleset-wipes-docker]]).
